title: VooPoo Drag X3 Pod Vape Kit
description: The Voopoo Drag X3 combines power that goes the distance with precise, intuitive control in a smart pod-mod design. Wrapped in soft faux-leather panels, the Drag X3 is as stylish as it is ergonomic. Delivering up to 80W from a single external 18650 or 21700 battery (sold separately) , it’s built to provide high performance with everyday practicality. The bright 1.66-inch touchscreen displays key data clearly, while the Gene.TT chipset provides responsive power delivery, smooth operation, and six safety features, including Overcharge and Short-Circuit Protection. This Gene.TT chipset also supports three distinct modes: Smart Mode automatically sets the correct wattage for your chosen coil, RBA Mode allows full manual adjustment for experienced users, and Eco Mode helps extend battery life and e-liquid use. The device also features a single multi-functional button used to fire, lock, or unlock the kit, complemented by a capacitive touch sensor for fast tap-to-unlock control—together offering effortless, intuitive operation. The supplied PnP X DTL pod uses a leak-resistant side-fill design and comes with 0.15ohm and 0.3ohm mesh coils for clear, consistent flavour with high-VG e-liquids. Adjustable airflow lets you fine-tune your draw between mouth-to-lung (MTL), restricted direct-to-lung (RDL) and direct-to-lung (DTL) styles. With fast USB-C 5V/2A charging and six onboard protections, the Drag X3 delivers the performance and reliability that define the Voopoo Drag range. Discover our vape juice online and find a flavour that complements this kit. Included Coils: For the best performance, we recommend using Sub-Ohm (High VG) E-Liquids with the coils included in this kit. If you prefer 50/50 (Freebase) or Nic Salt e-liquids , we suggest using 0.8ohm or 0.6ohm coils, available for purchase separately. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
